svg.title: activity — zsh
svg.desc: GitHub stats, the last year, commit rhythm, a punch card, top repos, commit types, the contribution snake and a swimming pixel koi with a legend.

g.text: $ git log --since='1 year' # the last 365 days
$ ./snake.sh # eats my contribution graph, square by square
$ git koi # a pixel koi that lives off my GitHub activity
# its patches are my languages, by share of repos
# it grows with every contribution; ticks = 500 / 1.5k / 12.75k
# streaks brighten the colors and paint the fin tips
# the day that just ended sets how it swims; redrawn every night
